sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Discretionary Portfolio Advisory for Multiple Private Client Families

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No bilateral investment treaty or double taxation agreement is separately in force for Vanuatu International Companies as at this Stage 1 assessment; applicable regional and multilateral trade instruments include the Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus, in force for Vanuatu since 2020) and the Vanuatu WTO Accession Protocol (2012).

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 (as amended and consolidated in the Laws of the Republic of Vanuatu), together with the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2022, the Financial Dealers Licensing Act, and the sub-ordinate beneficial ownership and AML/CFT Rules issued by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified and notarized passport bio-page or national identity card of each substantial shareholder, director, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport or national identity authority in the UBO's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO and source-of-wealth statement setting out the full ownership chain and control matrix, signed under penalty
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ultimate beneficial owner, family trustee, and licensed Vanuatu registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of incorporation certificate and certificate of good standing for each corporate shareholder or corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or competent companies registrar of the shareholder's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney and corporate authorisation in favour of the Vanuatu registered agent and proposed directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of execution and relevant corporate board of directors

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and confirmation of source of funds or family wealth issued by a regulated financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Correspondent bank or licensed financial institution holding the client relationship

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and authorised signatories against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, the consolidated United Nations Security Council sanctions list, and the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission AML/CFT domestic restrictive measures. PEP status is assessed in accordance with FATF Recommendations 12 and 22, using extended due diligence that includes source of funds and source of wealth verification, senior management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring of the PEP's family members and close associates.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission International Companies Registry online name clearance portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be submitted in Latin script using the English, French, or Bislama alphabets. Names derived from non-Latin scripts must be accompanied by a notarised transliteration and English translation. A permitted suffix is required, such as Limited, Ltd, Corporation, Corp, Incorporated, Inc, or the corresponding French or other recognised statutory equivalent.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be extended through the registered agent for one further 30-day period if expiry is imminent. If the Registrar rejects a proposed name, the applicant receives a formal refusal notice citing the statutory or policy ground. The applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 calendar days, attaching the refusal notice, legal submissions, and any alternative names. The Registrar will issue a written determination within 7 business days. A further adverse determination may be challenged before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu in its judicial review jurisdiction.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for an ISIC 6430 multi-family office requiring a VFSC financial dealer licence. The International Company must maintain a registered office and registered agent in Vanuatu, and the licensed financial dealer / multi-family office must maintain a physical place of business in Vanuatu, with records, management oversight, and a compliance function accessible to VFSC.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High; estimated 75-85% likelihood of at least one unannounced or short-notice physical on-site inspection within the first 18 months of licensing, given the high-risk special licence classification and the discretionary portfolio advisory activity.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule issued by VFSC

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Professional legal fee tariff and prevailing market rate

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 (as amended), ss. 5-23; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act No. 10 of 1993, ss. 5-12; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 7 of 2019 (as amended)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies Registry Division, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation issued upon filing of Form IC-01 together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital requirement; share capital may be denominated in any currency with zero par value shares permitted; no escrow account or paid-up capital deposit is required for an International Company
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Incorporator's appointment of the inaugural directors is confirmed and recorded. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Company subscribes to the initial issued shares, and the register of members is approved. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office shall be the address of the Registered Agent, VFSC-licensed, in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and the Registered Agent is retained to maintain statutory registers. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the named individuals are appointed Chief Executive Officer, Director of Compliance, and Company Secretary. RESOLVED FURTHER, that management is authorized to open bank accounts, appoint the Money Laundering Reporting Officer, adopt AML/CFT policies, and file the Securities Dealer Licence application with VFSC.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Registered Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry via authorized VFSC-licensed Registered Agents in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent; instruct the agent to submit a name reservation application with three alternative company names; obtain VFSC name clearance letter and execute the Registered Agent engagement and registered office consent agreement.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name (three alternatives)
Passport copies of intended directors and shareholder(s)
Certificate of good standing of corporate shareholder, if any
Registered Agent engagement letter
Declaration of intended International Company status and non-onshore business purpose
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name is rejected as unavailable or contrary to the International Companies Act, VFSC issues a name objection notice; the Registered Agent files an alternative name within 5 business days at no additional governmental fee for the first re-submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Dossier and Payment of Statutory Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry - e-Registry portal or physical counters, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute and file the Memorandum and Articles of Association, Form IC-01, director consents, statutory declaration of compliance, and registered office confirmation through the Registered Agent; pay the VFSC incorporation fee and obtain the stamped receipt as evidence of lodgement.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (signed)
Form IC-01 (application for incorporation)
Consent of each director (Form DIR-01)
Statutory Declaration of Compliance
Registered office and Registered Agent confirmation letter
Bank receipt or e-payment confirmation of VFSC filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a requisition or query, the Registered Agent files a written response with supplemental documents within 14 calendar days; documentary-only requisitions are cured without payment of an additional filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Establishment of Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, collect the physical Certificate of Incorporation or receive the electronic certified copy; open the statutory registers of members, directors, charges, and beneficial owners; ensure the Registered Agent files the Beneficial Ownership Return with VFSC within the statutory timeframe.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Certificate of Incumbency issued by the Registered Agent
Register of Members and Register of Directors
Register of Charges
Beneficial Ownership Register and VFSC filing receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains typographical or legal name errors, return the original certificate with a written correction application; VFSC re-issues the corrected certificate within 5 business days upon payment of a nominal amendment fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance Appointments and AML/CFT Reporting Entity Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC AML/CFT Supervision Unit; Municipal Business Licence Office (for onshore physical presence)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the First Board Meeting or adopt a unanimous written resolution to ratify share subscription, appoint the CEO, Compliance Director and Company Secretary, adopt the AML/CFT compliance manual, and appoint the Money Laundering Reporting Officer; register the company as a Reporting Entity with the VFSC AML/CFT Supervision Unit; obtain the municipal Business Licence if a physical office is opened onshore.
required_dossiers: Signed First Board Resolution minutes
AML/CFT policy manual and enterprise-wide risk assessment
Money Laundering Reporting Officer appointment deed
VFSC Reporting Entity registration form (VFSC-AML-01)
Vanuatu Municipal Business Licence application
KYC files of directors, shareholders, and beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AML/CFT registration returns a deficiency notice, remediate the compliance policies and resubmit the revised controls within 10 business days; VFSC may conduct a premises inspection before granting confirmation, and any municipal business licence rejection is appealable to the Municipal Licensing Board within 14 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Capital Markets and Securities Supervision Division, in coordination with the Municipal Business Licence Office for onshore activity
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Securities Dealer Licence (Investment Manager / Discretionary Portfolio Advisory category) under the Dealers in Securities Act [Cap. 70], endorsed for offshore Multi-Family Office operations

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 4 - Registration and Exempt tier; no full EIA required for administrative office operations; DEPC registration is mandatory only if interior fit-out works are undertaken or a standby diesel generator above 50 kVA is installed
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: office effluent must connect to the municipal sewer network or an approved septic system with no industrial discharge; Storage: any generator fuel storage up to 2,000 L requires bunded secondary containment per DEPC oil storage guidelines; Emissions: standby generator exhaust must not produce ground-level particulate concentrations exceeding WHO ambient air quality guideline of 50 µg/m3; Waste: e-waste, paper, and hazardous items must be transported by a DEPC-licensed waste carrier under applicable Vanuatu waste management regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services certificate of fire safety for commercial occupancy, including portable fire extinguishers, emergency egress signage, and smoke alarms; municipal structural inspection certificate confirming floor load rating of not less than 2.5 kPa for the leased office premises; Department of Labour workplace clearance covering occupational safety and health induction, first-aid provisions, and an approved building evacuation plan.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; online portal www.customs.gov.vu; International Company incorporation and annual registration via Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) portal www.vfsc.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned International Company, prepare notarized constitutional/imprint documents, register with VFSC under the International Companies Act [Cap 222], and obtain Certificate of Incorporation; this carries a registration number but not a revenue tax ID because ICs are tax-exempt. If the IC, exceptionally, makes in-Vanuatu taxable supplies or imports for local use, it must submit the Customs/Inland Revenue Form VAT-001 (Application for VAT Registration), provide the incorporation certificate, office address in Vanuatu, expected turnover, and evidence of local agent appointment; the department will issue a 10-digit VAT identification number. A physical domicile/registered office in Port Vila is required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, inheritance tax, or stamp duty; the International Company is expressly exempt under its license from all Vanuatu taxes and duties on offshore/non-resident activities; entity is treated as a separate juridical person but tax classification is 'exempt association' rather than pass-through or entity-level. Local-source commercial activity remains constitutionally limited for ICs and would bring VAT compliance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or elective pass-through classification exists under Vanuatu law. ICs automatically have entity-level legal personality with tax exemption; there are no hybrid mismatch elections, no CFC election, and no entity classification regimes comparable to US IRC Section 7701. The only 'election' available is voluntary VAT registration where the applicant anticipates making taxable supplies below the compulsory threshold (subject to IC business restrictions).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) under the VAT Act [Cap 80], administered by Customs and Inland Revenue
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 5,000,000 in expected taxable turnover over any 12-month period (USD-equivalent approx. 41,000); compulsory registration also applies without threshold for large importers and providers of imported services subject to reverse charge
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory electronic-invoicing platform, no real-time fiscal clearance system, and no digital stamping regime exists in Vanuatu. Tax invoices must be issued in physical form and carry the supplier's name, VAT ID, date, description, consideration, and 12.5% VAT amount; electronic transmission and storage are permitted but not required to be cleared by the Revenue Authority.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to (i) goods physically exported by the registered supplier and removed from Vanuatu within a prescribed period under customs control; (ii) services supplied wholly to a non-resident for use outside Vanuatu, including overseas portfolio advisory and discretionary asset-management services for offshore vehicles, where the benefit of the service is sustained wholly outside Vanuatu; (iii) international transport, insurance, and ancillary services. The supplier must retain documentation evidencing export and non-residence of the recipient; for MFO services, written service contract, investment mandate, and custodian records are required.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Form CED, lodged in ASYCUDA World)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate and SWIFT/FX transfer confirmation evidencing foreign-currency payment
Service Agreement / Discretionary Portfolio Mandate for offshore services
VAT registration certificate and evidence of exemption for IC license holder
If applicable, Certificate of Origin or manufacturer's export records
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Claims of export zero-rating are subject to review by Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue for at least 5 years from the date of supply. A knowingly false or fraudulent zero-rating return is punishable by a fine not exceeding VT 2,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 5 years, plus repayment of any VAT refunded and restoration of the VAT liability at 12.5% with 50% surcharge; deliberate omission of export documentation triggers retrospective clawback of all related input VAT credits and disqualifies the exporter from claiming refunds for a further compliance period; serious organized fraud may lead to criminal prosecution under the Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Act for predicate VAT fraud.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 112] and the Exchange Control Regulations, is the central bank and foreign-exchange authority; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) separately licenses the International Company (IC) and supervises its multi-family office conduct, while the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) directs AML/CFT surveillance. The Minister of Finance retains residual approval powers for exceptional exchange-control transactions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is convertible for bona fide current-account payments through RBV-licensed authorized dealers; capital-account flows by residents require prior approval, but an International Company is statutorily treated as non-resident, permitting free foreign-currency operation, unrestricted offshore settlement, and no requirement to convert foreign receipts into VUV. Practical hurdles: the VUV interbank market is thin and offshore VUV liquidity is scarce, so large conversions are executed by authorized dealers at negotiated AUD/USD cross rates with T+1 to T+3 settlement; profit, dividend, management-fee, and liquidation remittances to non-resident MFO principals face no exchange-control block and no Vanuatu withholding tax, subject to presentation of audited financial statements and the IC tax-exemption certificate.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory surrender of export proceeds, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation window for an IC; all receipts from discretionary portfolio advisory, custody services, and family-office management are treated as non-export foreign-exchange earnings and may be retained indefinitely in any authorized-dealer foreign-currency account. Filing obligations are limited to statistical balance-of-payments declaration via the bank and FIU cash/wire reporting above the USD 10,000 (approx. VUV 1,000,000) threshold; no RBV conversion form is triggered for IC treasury flows.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Multi-Currency Operating Account (USD/AUD/VUV) and segregated Client Money Trust Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Business Sweep Account for operational treasury
Operational Foreign-Currency Settlement Account (EUR/USD/AUD) and Escrow Account
Private-Wealth Custody Account and Discretionary Portfolio Clearing Account
VUV Operational Account with AUD/USD correspondent settlement
Escrow/Pledge Account for client investment mandates

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low-Medium. Vanuatu has no domestic e-money institution (EMI) licensing regime; foreign-regulated EMIs (for example FCA, BaFin, or MAS-licensed platforms) may lawfully hold the IC's non-resident liquidity but cannot serve as the licensed custodian or settlement bank required by the VFSC for discretionary MFO client assets. Legal constraints: EMIs are not RBV authorized dealers, so any VUV conversion must be routed through a licensed Vanuatu bank; VFSC client-money rules require trust-account custody at a regulated bank; and EMI wallets used to distribute funds to Vanuatu residents could trigger financial-customer licensing exposure under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act and Banking Act. Recommended use: low-value outbound administrative fees and short-term liquidity, not settlement-grade rails.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No blanket statutory mandate requires directors to appear physically; VFSC AML/CFT Rules permit remote onboarding through a licensed registered agent with video-verified identity, certified passports, and independent UBO verification. In practice, ANZ, BSP, and VP Bank require either an in-person meeting in Port Vila or a live read-back video interview with the principal director and the proposed AML Compliance Officer, while NBV and VCB accept fully remote opening upon notarized board resolutions, certified corporate documents, and a Vanuatu legal-opinion letter from the registered agent. A sworn KYC interview is mandatory before authority limits above high-value second-tier settlement thresholds (USD 100,000) are granted.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk sector designation: discretionary portfolio management and multi-family office flagged under VFSC AML/CFT Rule 9 and international ML risk indices, causing automatic underwriting rejection absent a licensed nexus.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC-issued securities dealer / investment manager licence certificate; board-approved AML/CFT compliance program; appointment certificate of a resident AML Compliance Officer; audited IC financial statements; IC Certificate of Good Standing and tax-exemption certificate; registered-office lease in Port Vila; client account structure diagram.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex or opaque beneficial ownership through layered trusts, foundations, or nominee shareholders triggers look-through failure in the bank's KYC engine.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified trust deed and current beneficiary register; legal opinion from Vanuatu-licensed counsel on UBO tracing; FATF-standard ownership and control chart; certified passports of settlors, trustees, and protectors; source-of-wealth report; statutory declaration of non-resident status under the International Companies Act [Cap 222].

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained source of wealth or rapid high-value third-party movement typical of MFO discretionary flows, raising red flags for layering and unexplained credit risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six months of originating foreign bank statements; independent portfolio valuations; executed purchase/sale contracts and dividend vouchers; external auditor letter confirming no tax-abuse or round-tripping structure; funds-flow matrix tracing every injection to named family principals; home-jurisdiction tax clearance or totalization certificates.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and PEP screening hit: family principals or key beneficiaries appear on PEP lists or high-risk jurisdiction matrices.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PEP risk assessment and mitigation plan; independent enhanced-due-diligence media and sanctions search; sworn AML declaration by the MFO controller; proof of public-office exit where applicable; indemnity from the family-office board; FIU-acknowledged enhanced monitoring protocol and periodic transaction-review commitment.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route injections via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code relating to equity contribution (narrative: 'Subscription to share capital of International Company - Multi-Family Office') or shareholder loan where applicable; pre-funding support bundle comprises the IC board resolution, updated share register, completed account-opening KYC/UBO forms, and the authorized dealer's exchange-control declaration form for VUV conversion. USD/AUD/EUR wire inflows can settle directly into the multi-currency operating account without RBV conversion approval, while VUV-denominated injections settle through the RBV interbank clearing system via the authorized dealer; banks verify economic substance through licence evidence, office lease, and payroll records before releasing funds for investment mandates.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103 for customer-initiated investment, fee, and client-distribution payments, with MT202 COV for interbank cover where VUV/USD settlement requires correspondent channels; for verified trade and custodian settlements, Commercial Letters of Credit governed by UCP600 are issued via the ANZ, BSP, or BRED trade desks with SWIFT MT700 issuance and MT798 amendment flows. Client-money disbursements must originate solely from the segregated trust account, cite the governing investment mandate and consent order, and require four-eyes treasury sign-off; portfolio trades settle via global custodians (for example Euroclear or Clearstream) with the Vanuatu bank acting as local clearing bridge and VUV treasury manager.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards (VUV/USD, VUV/AUD, VUV/EUR) executed with an RBV-licensed authorized dealer for documented current-account and capital-flow commitments
Non-deliverable VUV forwards (NDFs) with non-resident global banks under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement, settled in USD so as to avoid onshore convertibility constraints
Cross-currency swaps (USD/AUD/EUR/VUV) matching MFO portfolio currency exposure and funding liabilities, subject to board-approved treasury policy and minuted risk limits
Vanilla FX options (call/put) for overlay hedging of client-basis currency volatility, executed through approved non-resident prime brokers

Structural natural hedging via multi-currency nostro accounts and periodic currency-basket rebalancing, requiring no exchange-control approval but reported in FIU cash-transaction filings above the statutory threshold

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Vanuatu International Company annual renewal license (registered agent filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 December based on incorporation anniversary; grace period allowed by VFSC in December
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty of 20% of the annual fee after 31 December; continued non-payment for 3 months triggers administrative dissolution (strike-off) by the VFSC after notice in the Gazette and to the registered agent.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual declaration of registered agent confirmation and shareholder/UBO register status
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with annual renewal fee payment, on or before 31 December
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to update the beneficial ownership register may result in a monetary penalty under the International Companies Act; continued default may constitute an offence and invalidate the annual license.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit for a standard Vanuatu International Company. A mandatory audit is imposed only if the company holds a VFSC special financial services license (e.g., investment advisory, dealing in securities) under the Dealers in Securities Act or the Investment Business Act, in which case audited financial statements must be filed annually with the VFSC.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) for VFSC-licensed entities; unlicensed International Companies are generally not required to adopt any prescribed accounting standard and may maintain records in a manner consistent with local GAAP or IFRS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must obtain and record full beneficial ownership details at incorporation and upon each shareholding transfer. Annually, as part of the VFSC renewal, the registered agent must confirm that the registered beneficial ownership information is current and accurate, including the date, nature and consideration of any transfer. Failure to promptly notify the agent of a transfer within 14 days is subject to penalty in the name of the transferor and the directors.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of shareholder and director meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$800 - US$1,500 per year depending on service provider and compliance burden
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$4,000 - US$8,000 per year if a VFSC financial license requires a certified audit; otherwise US$0

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu International Companies (ICs) are fully exempt from corporate income tax, capital gains tax, and all withholding taxes. No income tax law imposes chargeable income on an IC. The only recurring central cost is the VFSC annual renewal fee and the registered agent fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Not applicable for income tax; no CIT return, no sales tax return, and no equivalent revenue return exists for a Vanuatu International Company. The sole annual statutory compliance filing is the 'Annual Return of an International Company' submitted to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through the VFSC online e-Registry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The VFSC annual return is due within 28 calendar days following each incorporation anniversary. Failure to file by the due date enters the company into the late renewal regime; the exact late period is calculated from the anniversary date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: No income tax schedules, balance-sheet-to-tax adjustments, transfer-pricing disclosures, or tax reconciliation are required. The VFSC annual return identifies the company name, registration number, registered agent, registered office in Vanuatu, directors, shareholders, and any amendments to constitutional documents or principal officers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders and directors have no local tax filing obligation. Foreign-resident principals must instead report any Vanuatu-sourced income under their own domestic tax rules; Vanuatu imposes no duty on the IC to withhold, report, or transmit tax on foreign investor distributions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the VFSC annual return triggers a late penalty assessed by the VFSC, scaled to the period elapsed after the anniversary. Persistent non-compliance can lead to risk-based inspection, monetary penalties, and striking-off or dissolution of the International Company. Directors and the registered agent may be held responsible for the default.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) is in force for Vanuatu. Only tax information exchange agreements (TIEAs) and administrative cooperation arrangements exist. Because the statutory dividend withholding tax rate is zero, there is no withholding tax to relieve, no treaty relief application form, and no requirement to obtain a Vanuatu tax residency certificate (TRC) for dividend distributions from an International Company.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% for both royalties and interest. No treaty rate override applies. Foreign recipients of royalties from a Vanuatu IC and foreign lenders receiving interest from a Vanuatu IC are not subject to Vanuatu withholding tax.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: N/A (no statutory threshold in VUV; there is no mandatory Local File or Master File requirement under Vanuatu law for International Companies).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not currently impose a dedicated Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) regime equivalent to BVI, Cayman, or Jersey. However, ICs must maintain a registered office and registered agent in Vanuatu. The VFSC treats substance, effective management, and commercial rationale as material indicators when evaluating licensing, AML/CFT risk, and good-standing applications. For a licensed multi-family office, maintaining substantive portfolio management, board oversight, client due-diligence records, and staff in a reputable jurisdiction is commercially advisable to prevent classification as a shell entity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu International Company to conceal economic ownership of investment assets or to hide income from foreign tax authorities, including failing to disclose beneficial ownership while repatriating profits to undisclosed principals.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Although Vanuatu levies no local income tax, such conduct is a criminal offense under applicable Vanuatu penal, proceeds-of-crime, and anti-money-laundering legislation. Consequences may include VFSC deregistration, confiscation of assets, civil penalties, and criminal fines. Cooperation with foreign tax agencies under exchange-of-information instruments can also expose the entity to downwards reporting and administrative sanctions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, nominee officers, and beneficial owners may have the corporate veil pierced where the IC is used for fraud or evasion. Personal civil restitution, asset freezes, travel bans, and imprisonment are possible. Under proceeds-of-crime powers, the court may order confiscation of property derived from unlawful conduct.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the IC as a pure passport-through shell with no physical commercial substance, no local decision-making, no substantive records, and no demonstrated legitimate purpose, especially in a regulated multi-family-office activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The VFSC may refuse the annual renewal, issue adverse findings, or strike the company off the International Companies Register. Financial penalties and license revocation can apply to licensed activity. International standard-setting bodies may identify the vehicle as a high-risk shell subject to enhanced due diligence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be held jointly and severally liable for continued trading or licensed activity without substance or proper authorization. In addition to deregistration, civil liability to creditors and regulatory fines may attach. Personal travel restrictions or bans on holding directorship positions in Vanuatu may be imposed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Breach – Beneficial Ownership, Client Due Diligence, and Suspicious Transactions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a licensed discretionary portfolio advisory business without implementing a risk-based AML/CFT framework: failure to identify and verify clients' beneficial owners, failure to maintain transaction records, failure to report suspicious activity or large cash transactions, and providing anonymous custody/wire access.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Stringent fines and penalties are payable under Vanuatu's Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act and Financial Intelligence Unit directives. The VFSC can suspend or revoke the multi-family-office license, freeze accounts, and impose monetary administrative penalties against the company and its controllers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers face criminal liability for deliberate or reckless AML failures. Sanctions include imprisonment, fines, and debarment from management duties. Civil confiscation of director and beneficial owner assets is possible where those assets derive from money laundering or terrorist financing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Filings / Misleading VFSC and Licensing Representations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly submitting false annual returns, forged beneficial-ownership declarations, false registered-agent confirmations, or materially misleading financial information to the VFSC, banks, or custody service providers while operating as an international-company multi-family office.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The VFSC may void or correct the company registration, impose financial penalties, revoke the license, and report the matter to the Public Prosecutor. Fraudulent filing carries criminal-law exposure under the International Companies Act and general criminal statutes, including monetary fines and imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or cause false declarations are personally accountable. They can be ordered to pay restitution, removed and disqualified, subjected to travel bans, and imprisoned. Regulatory authorities may also require the registered agent to resign, thereby triggering automatic default and potential compulsory striking-off.
